title: Psychometric Survey Screening, Reverse-Coding, and Composite Aggregation
description: Authoritative academic behavioral benchmark case for DATA_CLEANING.
research_question: Are multi-item psychological scales appropriately screened for range violations, reverse-coded, and aggregated into reliable composite indicators?

must_do.description: Identify and reverse-code negatively phrased items 4, 7, and 10 using formula: 6 - x.
Screen for invalid response values outside 1-5 Likert range.
Compute verified composite total score preserving transparent audit log.

must_not_do.description: Sum or average raw items without reverse-coding negative indicators.
Destructively overwrite original raw survey columns without audit trail.

required_evidence.description: Transformation audit log mapping raw items to reverse-coded items.
Cleaned dataset with verified SHA256 and composite scores.
